invariant: only the owner whose claim_generation equals recovery_generation may record completion

contract: value must be an exact Python int; bool is rejected

protocols.claim: CAS shared branch with exact expected_sha and force=false; successful claimant records claim_generation equal to current recovery_generation
protocols.expire: separate reaper may advance recovery_generation exactly once and set action.state=LEASE_EXPIRED only while action is CLAIMED; preserve prior_owner
protocols.recovery_claim: new worker may claim LEASE_EXPIRED action only at current recovery_generation via exact-head CAS
protocols.completion: completion allowed only when action.owner is caller and claim_generation equals current recovery_generation; exact-head CAS required
protocols.stale_completion: old owner completion must be rejected by stale expected_sha or by ownership/generation check after reread
